patches.name: ElevenLabs voice for navigation
patches.description: Speaks navigation instructions and alerts with an ElevenLabs voice. Adds an "ElevenLabs voice" entry to Waze settings for the API key, voice and model. Waze's own voice plays whenever ElevenLabs is off, not configured or unreachable.
